verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code review product that also generates fixes ("Fix with cubic" pushes a single fix to the PR branch), so a buyer could fairly ask about parallel task attempts. However, nothing in the evidence shows running multiple attempts in parallel and comparing them before choosing one. Codebase scans that deploy many agents to find bugs are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
